command: pre-registration: R4b non-circular on-manifold judge for R4-bind's stage 0 (+ stage 1 if it passes)

metrics.bars: outlier rise <= 0.10; |normalised action| > 1 rise <= 0.05; still (< 2 cm) rise <= 0.10
metrics.choice: max g_cf among admissible; ties 0.005 -> smaller w, early before all, d1 before dir; rb4b_stage0 first
metrics.disclosure: seen before this row: R4-bind's complete stage-0 table under the OLD judge (results/rb4/stage0.json: g_cf, g_named, still, action range, old FM-outlier rise for all 12 configs; stage 0 failed, no config chosen), and R3b/R3c/R2a/OF published results. Binding-source coverage (no policy output): tuning Y 32 / 250 (tasks ['libero_90:16', 'libero_90:32', 'libero_90:40']), named 66 / 250; test named sources {"wo_pre": 0, "su_pre": 220, "wg_post": 1, "su_post": 93}; rule reproduces R3c's named sources (1084 agree, 0 disagree). Movability is fixed by the stored chunks (recomputed, asserted equal to R4-bind's). HARD-RULE slip during development: one `python3 -` heredoc was issued on the login node and blocked by the harness before it ran.
metrics.fixed_from_rb4: guidance form, 12-config grid, tuning pool (R3b's 250), cf target Y (rs3 cf_pick), noise floor, movability bar g_cf >= 0.130, secondary bars, admissibility, tie rule, stage-1 H1-H4
metrics.judge_fallback: the same under the null prompt '' where Y has no binding source; gate statistic pooled
metrics.judge_primary: FM (t {0.1,0.2,0.3,0.5} x 4 noises seed 5) of the guided |cf chunk under a same-scene train_l90 instruction whose BDDL In/On goal moves Y (R3c oracle rule, lowest sha1 rs4src:{task}:O:{Y}:{cell}); reference = own unguided chunks under that prompt, seeds 11 / 21; outlier = FM > mean + 2 sd of ref11's 12; rise = guided share - ref21 share, episode means, task-cluster bootstrap
metrics.reuse: R4-bind's stored tuning chunks inverted through the affine output transform (round trip < 1e-4 asserted; instruction FM reproduced on 2 obs per shard); no guided chunk regenerated
metrics.stage1: only if stage 0 passes: R4-bind's pre-registered stage 1 unchanged except the judge (vision anchor = SigLIP prototypes + depth at the episode start state; oracle-anchor arm = privileged upper bound; goal-anchor localisation first; H1 wo_pre rise >= 0.20 CI excl 0; H2 su_pre drop <= 0.05; H3 wg_post as H1; H4 su_post as H2; Holm over H1-H4 at 0.05; gate H1 & H2); stage 2 out of scope
metrics.why: R4-bind's on-manifold judge (FM under the current, misbound conditioning) penalises a correct approach to an unbound object by construction (circular); R4b replaces only that judge
metrics.written_before: any R4b judge flow loss, any R4b stage-0 statistic, any test observation
